subject: Request: short quote & case study permission — POC with ClearPath Health
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Morgan <leah@clearpath.health>, Amit Rao <amit@clearpath.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: short quote & case study permission — POC with ClearPath Health

Hi Leah / Amit,

Thanks again for running the pilot with us over the last three weeks — really appreciate the team's time. We put together a short recap of results and a suggested way to use this in a one-page case study. Key highlights from the POC (attached):

- Inference median latency reduced from ~420ms -> ~160ms (62% reduction) for the 512-token typical path.
- Cost per successful inference (after batching + KV cache) down ~38% on average.
- Error rate on timeout/failed responses dropped from 3.7% -> 0.8%.
- 99th percentile latency improved by ~230ms during peak load periods.

Attachments: clearpath_poc_results.pdf (full report), latency_chart.png (dashboard snapshot).

Would ClearPath be open to:
1) A short, 1–2 sentence customer quote we can include in a public case study; and
2) A 15-minute recorded call with one of your engineers + Leah for a quick on-record quote and a screenshot approval?

If yes, here are a couple of suggested quote drafts you can edit:
- "Redwood's inference platform reduced our end-to-end latency by over 60% in production workloads while lowering per-request cost significantly."
- "We saw predictable performance at scale during the pilot — latency and reliability improvements were clear."

Proposed times for a 15-min call (PST): Mon 2/23 10:00–11:00, Mon 2/23 14:00–15:00, Tue 2/24 09:00–10:00. If you prefer, feel free to suggest another time and I’ll route it to our marketing/comms lead.

We'd also be happy to share the one-pager draft (Google Doc) ahead of the call for quick sign-off: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdEFghiJkCaseStudyDraft

Thanks — excited about the next steps.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
[Attachment: clearpath_poc_results.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: latency_chart.png (PNG)]

Connor,

Really pleased with the results — the dashboard you sent lines up with what our frontend team experienced during the pilot. Happy to help.

Short answers:
- Quote: yes; I'm comfortable with a 1–2 sentence line. Suggestion below (feel free to tweak):
  "Working with Redwood reduced our inference latency by ~60% in production-like workloads while lowering cost and improving reliability — a clear win for our patient-facing pipelines."

- Call: we can do 15 minutes. Amit (cc'd) will bring the engineer who ran the integration. Procurement looped in to confirm any paperwork for publishing.

Amit — can you confirm availability Mon 2/23 14:00 PST? Also, procurement, please advise if you need an NDA addendum or standard approval form before Redwood publishes.

If you want us to review the Google Doc ahead of the call, send it over; I'll have legal look at the final quote language.

Thanks,
Leah Morgan

leah@clearpath.health | +1 212-555-0190
